understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to reach the tile marked '+' in each level, completing the current BP35 level and continuing until the game was won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement was horizontal using MOVE_LEFT or MOVE_RIGHT, after which gravity automatically carried the player until landing on a solid tile or reaching the goal. Gravity direction determined whether the player fell toward smaller or larger y-values. CLICK removed clickable breakable blocks at a specified coordinate without moving the player, allowing new fall paths. Landing on spike tiles ended the attempt, while UNDO reverted the previous action.
